goal: Evaluate source-scoped Librarian search and live Jev exact-range selection on a small four-project bilingual-independent cohort with positive and unanswerable controls.

plan.independentUnit: four distinct project repositories; one positive and one source-scoped unanswerable query per project
secondaryMetrics: selected range line overlap and overbreadth
plan.uncertaintyMethod: descriptive counts only; cohort far below 30 independent examples per subgroup
plan.metadataScope: metadataMode=off; explicit single sourceRef per request; this pilot does not test atom projection or automatic source discovery
plan.emptyPoolRule: if search returns no handles, record no-candidate and do not call Jev

corpus.sourceRevision: file SHA-256, tracked target cleanliness, repository HEAD/branch, and frozen snapshot
corpus.labelSource: two independent source-only reviewers; analyst labels, not owner-gold

labels.source: independent source-only reviews; analyst labels; not repository-owner gold

provider.provider: TypeSafe Jev through the connected MauroPrime Bridge MCP
provider.networkAuthorization: User previously authorized real Jev calls and use of stored credential; no secret value persisted

sourceNotes: BeeIncremental AGENTS.md names historical .bridge project facts; this run uses only the canonical .mssr load and explicit tracked source file, never .bridge as authority.

Kairos project-context health reports docs/CONTRACTS.md as a high-priority disconnected documentation candidate; this run deliberately supplies that exact sourceRef and does not claim automatic source/atom discovery.
